summary.name: Interior AI
summary.one_liner: Interior AI is a web and mobile app that redesigns photos of real rooms, furnishes empty spaces, and renders sketches in many interior styles using AI.
use_cases: Redesigning a room from a photo of your own home
Staging empty rooms for real estate listings
Turning interior sketches or SketchUp screenshots into realistic renders
Generating garden and outdoor design ideas from a photo
Exploring interior style ideas before buying furniture
summary.what_it_does: Users upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF photo of a room, choose one of 55+ interior styles or write their own prompt, and receive a redesigned photorealistic image in roughly half a minute. Modes include 3D-vision and 2D-photo interior redesign, Virtual Staging AI for furnishing empty rooms, Freestyle generation without an input photo, Sketch2Image for converting sketches to renders, and SketchUp screenshot rendering. An outdoor design mode adds plants and garden elements to exterior photos. The page also describes turning renders into immersive 3D walkthroughs.
notable: Virtual Staging AI mode for furnishing empty listing photos
Sketch2Image and SketchUp screenshot conversion to photorealistic renders
Commercial use license on paid plans
caveats: Paid plans: Pro at $29/month billed yearly ($349/yr) or $49/month; Ultra at $99/month yearly ($1199/yr) or $199/month
Pro plan renders are lower quality; Ultra offers photorealistic renders
HEIC photos are not supported and must be converted to JPG first
Payment signup may be blocked if VPN/proxy is used or card details do not match
